results.description:
A heartwarming small-town holiday romance filled with charm, unexpected connection, and the joy of finding home. 🎄✨

Lacey Lane is a city girl and driven producer searching for the perfect location for her hit reality show. When she arrives in snow-dusted Christmas Mountain, she's chasing more than just a filming spot. Raised in foster care, Lacey dreams of earning the producer bonus that could finally give her a forever home.

Jacob Curtis, the local innkeeper, loves his town and wants to protect its magic from becoming just another TV backdrop. Posing as Lacey's charming tour guide, he tries to steer her away — but Lacey's no fool. The more time they share, the harder it is to ignore the spark growing between them.

From a New York Times bestselling author, don't miss this cozy holiday romance about believing in love, embracing second chances, and discovering where you truly belong in A SUGAR PLUM CHRISTMAS.

★★★★★ "Great characters, set in a charming Christmas town. It's such an enjoyable read you don't
want to miss out!!" — Doni, Amazon Review

★★★★★ "This is the perfect Christmas romance book! I already told my husband that we are moving to Christmas Mountain so I can experience that magic every day!" — Nikki, Goodreads Review

★★★★★ "Christmas Mountain stories always lift me up. There's a story behind every person who comes to the mountain and the love of their lives they meet there." — Wac Veteran, Amazon Review
